title: Mamaolo village, Ga-Mphahlele (Maribeng Section, approx.): tavern owner, 53, found murdered and robbed, 2 Oct

story: Police say a 53-year-old tavern owner was found by his sister at his business premises at Ga-Mphahlele, Maribeng Section, in Mamaolo village outside Lebowakgomo. The garage doors were open and he was lying face down in a pool of blood after being struck with a sharp object; cash and his white Isuzu bakkie were taken (police spokesperson Hlulani Mashaba, via SABC News). Lebowakgomo police are investigating business robbery and murder and launched a manhunt. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. One public report, resting on police: SABC News, 3 October; the SAPS Limpopo media statement says the same. The pin is approximate (village level).
incident: Fri 2 Oct 2026, found by his sister; time not given (SAPS Limpopo statement of 2 Oct; SABC News)

location_note: At his tavern business premises at Ga-Mphahlele, Maribeng Section, Mamaolo village, outside Lebowakgomo (police, via SABC News). Address not given. Maribeng Section was not found on a map and Mamaolo has no village point in the place-name lookups used; the pin is the centre of the mapped Mamaolo landmarks (school, taxi rank, cemetery, fuel station), inside the Lebowakgomo police precinct. Approximate, village level (about 3 km).
